description: Fused Geospatial Dataset of Road Infrastructure and Climate Hazards for Victoria, Australia is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Teck Kean Chin (Monash University). This dataset integrates road infrastructure and climate hazard data for 7,579 road links in Victoria, Australia, supporting the Road Infrastructure Climate Risk Assessment Framework (RICRAF). Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
